title: Break the Loop
subtitle: A treatment-strategy game about symptom feedback and the network theory of mental disorders.
learning_goals: Explain how reinforcing interactions between symptoms can sustain a high-activity network state.
Distinguish a one-time symptom intervention from changes to an interaction or a node's activation field.
Compare intervention strategies under a limited budget, including exact Ising forecasts and simulation-based continuous-time forecasts.
creator: Denny Borsboom
notes: Educational prototype with two underlying models. Choose Ising or the continuous-time symptom model of Park, Waldorp & Vasconcelos (2026), Eq. 2, Table 2 normal beta, Table 3 base self/boost and Appendix A4 directed matrix. Ising uses random-scan Gibbs updates and exact 512-state forecasts. The continuous model uses reflected Euler–Maruyama integration (dt=0.02), independent Gaussian noise (sigma=0.10), initial levels 0.92, a green display band <=0.10, 20 time units per treatment, optional free 10-unit observation, and 256-path estimates at horizon 40. These numerical and game settings are illustrative. Node intervention: 1 coin, once only; set off in Ising or reduce intensity by 0.25 in the continuous model, with a floor of 0.10 and no clamping. A high-intensity symptom is not forced green. Continuous self-feedback starts at 0.30 and is drawn as a loop at every node; a separate 1-coin intervention lowers one coefficient to 0.10 without resetting intensity or changing other parameters. This cannot stack on an already lowered loop. Forecasts and undo support self-feedback changes. All four continuous-model interventions cost 1 coin each. Ising prices remain node 1, field 2, edge 3 coins. Field shifts reduce tau by 1.5 in Ising or beta by 0.25 in the continuous model, lasting for the round. Edge removal affects a symmetric connection in Ising and one directed influence in the continuous model. Forecasts and undo each cost 1 coin; undo restores the network, clock, tips and RNG but does not refund earlier spending. Six coins per round. All nine green together wins a trophy; exhaustion opens Play again. Not fitted patient data or a clinical recovery rule.
